title: CRANE: Reasoning with constrained LLM generation
reviewed_version: publisher proceedings version at retrieval; immutable local SHA-256
inspection_outcome: Two Major claim-bounded findings and one Minor reporting finding
summary: Printed central grammar has empty language and false trace-containment step, with a complete epsilon-rule repair. Released equivalence checker changes floor-division precedence and can accept wrong paper-bound answer. Historical score effect remains unverified. Minor model-specific reporting inconsistencies.
limitations: No author code, model inference, solver or evaluator execution.
Imported transformer-simulation theorems not independently reconstructed from their source publications.
No exhaustive review of vendored code or every implementation path.

problems.title: Augmented grammar has no terminating production
problems.location: Section3.2 p.5 and Proposition3.3 proof p.14
problems.claim: Printed RM grammar contains every finite simulator trace.
problems.assumptions: Standard CFG finite derivations; RM->S RM only; G can output0; deterministic halting machine.
problems.check: Every finite derivation retains RM; productivity fixed point excludes RM and Ga.
problems.counterevidence: Text and proof indicate intended Kleene-star language; repaired existence claim survives; practical Algorithm1 does not use RM.
problems.impact: Invalid formal construction closely tied to central grammar-augmentation contribution, not merely cosmetic punctuation.
problems.correction: Add RM->epsilon; prove L(RM)=Gamma* by both inclusions, restoring containment conditional on imported simulator.

problems.title: Released evaluator changes floor-division precedence
problems.outcome: Demonstrated incorrect core validation rule in reviewed release
problems.location: src/prompting/gsm_symbolic.py74-80,170-205; Listing1 p.15; grammar p.19; evaluation p.7
problems.claim: Generated symbolic expressions are checked for functional equivalence to reference.
problems.assumptions: Allowed gold y//d*t; candidate y//(d*t); positive integers y=12,d=3,t=2; no zero denominator, exception or timeout required.
problems.check: Static regex maps both to floor(y/(d*t)); intended gold is8 and candidate2.
problems.result: Checker's identical-expression unsat branch accepts the wrong expression.
problems.counterevidence: Pinned release not proven historical experiment revision; actual affected scores and rankings unknown; solver itself not at fault.
problems.impact: Major for validation mechanism directly used in released core benchmark scoring; historical score effect separately Needs Evidence.
problems.correction: AST-based operator-preserving translation required; witness corrected analytically only, not complete repaired evaluator.
